title: Service Metadata
description: Top-level descriptor for a SaaS service entry in the catalog. Identifies the service, its vendor, the domains it serves, and how deeply the entry has been researched (Level 1-3).

vendor.description: Legal or commonly used vendor / operator name (e.g. 'Figma, Inc.').

category.description: Broad functional category. Used for grouping in UIs.

domains.description: All domains (including subdomains) that should map to this service entry when matched against browser history.

homepage.description: Primary marketing URL for the service.

first_seen.description: Date this entry was first added to the catalog (ISO 8601).

last_updated.description: Date this metadata file was last meaningfully updated (ISO 8601).

level.description: Depth of research available for this service. 1 = domain + name + category only; 2 = + ToS/Privacy URLs; 3 = + per-plan policies and recommended settings.

aliases.description: Alternative names or brand variants the service is also known by (e.g. 'FigJam' under Figma).

source.description: Provenance for entries imported from an external dataset (e.g. ToSDR bootstrap). Omitted for entries authored directly in this repository.

provider.description: Identifier of the upstream data source.

id.description: Stable identifier within the upstream dataset (string or integer).

imported_at.description: Date this entry was imported from the upstream dataset (ISO 8601).
